_note: Governance policy. Generated assets (no authored .bbmodel source) are deterministic and reproducible from the queue, so they are auto-approved. Authored assets (those with a source in conversions.json, e.g. Blockbench java_block exports) require an explicit human review. A human reject/review in reviews.json always wins over policy. This keys on the committed 'source', so re-indexing is idempotent.
